_help: Copy this file to repos.json (Install-ContextMenu.ps1 does this for you) and edit it. repos.json is gitignored.
'repoRoots' are the folders the repo picker scans for git repositories (up to 'repoScanDepth' levels deep). Environment variables such as %USERPROFILE% are expanded.
Keys under 'repos' are a full repo path or just the repo folder name (case-insensitive).
Each start point needs 'label' and 'branch', plus either 'base' (branch/commit to start from)
or 'pick' (a branch pattern such as 'feature/*' - you choose one of the matching branches).
Placeholders in 'branch': {name} = agent name, {picked} = chosen branch, {pickedSuffix} = the part matched by '*'.
'fetch': true fetches the base from origin on the host before creating the worktree.
'defaultBranch' (global or per repo) names branches for 'Current branch', 'Pick a branch' and 'Type a branch'.
The first start point is the default (Enter). 'Current branch', 'Pick a branch' and 'Type a branch' are always added.
